title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - LoadControlStateData
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/LoadControlStateData. The representation of the state of an event used to send overload warning severity level and related load control commands to a device (e.g. a household appliance or a smart meter).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LoadControlStateData'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTimestamp.description: Property. The time the load control state information instance was created or received.

hasAppliedEventActionConsume.description: Property. A relationship between the state of a load control event consume and the action to be performed as a consequence of this event. Controlled vocabulary (EventActionConsume).

hasAppliedEventActionProduce.description: Property. A relationship between the state of a load control event produce and the action to be performed as a consequence of this event. Controlled vocabulary (EventActionProduce).

hasEventStateConsume.description: Property. A relationship between the specification of the state of a load control event consume and the value that this state can assume. Controlled vocabulary (EventStateConsume).

hasEventStateProduce.description: Property. A relationship between the specification of the state of a load control event produce and the value that this state can assume. Controlled vocabulary (EventStateProduce).

hasIdentifier.description: Property. A unique identifier for this load control state, matching the identifier used in the related LoadControlEventData.
